town_description: Belonia is the headquarters town of South Tripura district near the Bangladesh border, set on the Muhuri river plain. It is known for Trishna Wildlife Sanctuary, Belonia Eco Park and local shrines such as the Yogmaya Kali Temple and Ram Thakur Smriti Mandir, and has its own railway station on the Agartala-Sabroom line.
